full_judgment: 9. Evidently this very decision of the Appeal Arbitration Committee was not legal at all. The Appeal and Arbitration Committee found the dismissal order of the petitioner not in accordance with law for the reason that he was not put under suspension and given suspension allowance. The provision of putting a teacher under suspension during the period of any inquiry against him is not mandatory at all. So, the Board in its meeting dated 20-2-2001 rightly decided thus :  “২৩-৯-২০০০ তারিখ আপীল এন্ড আরবিট্রেশন কমিটির সভায় ২ নং প্রস্তাবের সুপারিশ উক্ত কমিটির পরবর্তী সভায় সংশোধন করে বোর্ড সভায় পেশ করার সিদ্ধান্ত গৃহীত হয় ।  ”
